title: Normalized constant/completed strict reduction transport
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, with valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$ and ideal $I=(\varpi_E)$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. On each small pro-etale site use the actual completed coefficient system $\widehat R_T$ [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data] and the strict reduction/limit calculus [def-sf-integral-system-operations]. Define $H_T$ as exact derived restriction along $\underline R_T\to\widehat R_T$, followed by the fixed exact small-site model equivalence. Define $U_T$ as exact derived termwise restriction of the strict positive-quotient system to constant $R$-module towers [def-cbc-strict-constant-tower-operations], with the same site model. Let $\mathcal R_T^R$ be derived reduction to the single strict diagram $R/I^{n+1}$, $n\geq0$, and $L_T=R\lim$ on that diagram category. The datum $d=(R,I)$ has the actual uniformizer ideal. Define $\rho_T:\mathcal R_T^{\widehat R}U_T\simeq H_T\mathcal R_T^R$ by the unique normalization on flat-term K-flat representatives: both sides are the same strict complex modulo $I^{n+1}$, identified by the ordinary scalar-extension unit comparison at every degree and every transition. The normalization is an equality of maps in the derived category of whole strict towers. This names the existing functors, ordinary scalar restrictions, constant reduction, total limit, representative normalization and its uniquely determined isomorphism; it asserts no proper/open generator-coherence theorem.
